title: The Resurrection and the Great Commission

questions.question: When the Sabbath was past, who brought spices so that they might go and anoint Jesus' body?
options: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome
Peter, John, and Andrew
Joanna, Susanna, and Martha
Nicodemus and Joseph of Arimathea
questions.correctAnswer: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome
questions.explanation: Mark 16:1 (ESV): "When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, so that they might go and anoint him."

questions.question: Very early on the first day of the week, when did the women arrive at the tomb?
options: When the sun had risen
At midnight
As the sun was setting
Before the darkest hour
questions.explanation: Mark 16:2 (ESV): "And very early on the first day of the week, when the sun had risen, they went to the tomb."

questions.question: What were the women saying to one another on their way to the tomb?
options: "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance of the tomb?"
"Will the guards let us inside the tomb?"
"Do we have enough spices for his broken body?"
"Should we wake Peter to come with us?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance of the tomb?"
questions.explanation: Mark 16:3 (ESV): "And they were saying to one another, 'Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance of the tomb?'"

questions.question: When looking up, what did the women see concerning the stone?
options: They saw that the stone had been rolled back—it was very large
They saw an angel sitting upon the stone
The stone had been shattered into pieces by an earthquake
Roman soldiers were leaning against the stone
questions.correctAnswer: They saw that the stone had been rolled back—it was very large
questions.explanation: Mark 16:4 (ESV): "And looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled back—it was very large."

questions.question: Upon entering the tomb, who did the women see sitting on the right side?
options: A young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe
Jesus, glowing with the brilliance of heaven
Peter and John, who had arrived earlier
Two guards sleeping on the cold floor
questions.correctAnswer: A young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe
questions.explanation: Mark 16:5 (ESV): "And entering the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed."

questions.question: What did the young man say to the alarmed women regarding Jesus of Nazareth?
options: "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen; he is not here. See the place where they laid him."
"He is dead as was declared by Pilate."
"He will return at the end of the age to judge."
"He has ascended directly to the Father from the cross."
questions.correctAnswer: "Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen; he is not here. See the place where they laid him."
questions.explanation: Mark 16:6 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has risen; he is not here. See the place where they laid him.'"

questions.question: Which specific disciple did the young man single out when telling the women who to inform?
options: Peter
John
Thomas
Judas
questions.explanation: Mark 16:7 (ESV): "But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he is going before you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you."

questions.question: Where would Jesus be going before them, according to the young man?
options: To Galilee
To Jerusalem
To Bethany
To the Mount of Olives
questions.explanation: Mark 16:7 (ESV): "...he is going before you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you."

questions.question: How did the women react immediately after hearing the young man's words?
options: They went out and fled from the tomb, trembling and astonished, and said nothing to anyone out of fear
They sang praises to God all the way to Jerusalem
They wept and embraced him, believing instantly
They fell down and worshipped the young man as an angel
questions.correctAnswer: They went out and fled from the tomb, trembling and astonished, and said nothing to anyone out of fear
questions.explanation: Mark 16:8 (ESV): "And they went out and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had seized them, and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid."

questions.question: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week (according to the longer ending of Mark), to whom did He appear first?
options: To Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons
To His mother Mary
To Peter, who was weeping
To two disciples walking in the country
questions.correctAnswer: To Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons
questions.explanation: Mark 16:9 (ESV): "Now when he rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons."

questions.question: When Mary Magdalene told the disciples (who were mourning and weeping) that she had seen Jesus alive, did they believe her?
options: They would not believe it
They rejoiced heavily
They demanded she take them to him
They sent her back to the tomb to wait for more signs
questions.explanation: Mark 16:11 (ESV): "But when they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they would not believe it."

questions.question: When Jesus finally appeared to the eleven as they were reclining at table, what did He rebuke them for?
options: For their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen
For failing to defend Him in Gethsemane
For breaking their fast during the Sabbath
For discussing who was the greatest once again
questions.correctAnswer: For their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen
questions.explanation: Mark 16:14 (ESV): "Afterward he appeared to the eleven themselves... and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen."

questions.question: What command did Jesus give the disciples regarding the whole creation?
options: "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation."
"Tell the rulers of Rome what you have seen."
"Gather the lost sheep of Israel alone into communities."
"Write these words on stone tablets for future generations."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation."
questions.explanation: Mark 16:15 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation.'"

questions.question: According to Jesus in Mark 16, what will be the result for whoever believes and is baptized, and for whoever does not believe?
options: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned
Both will finally reach paradise if their deeds are righteous
The believer will be wealthy, and the unbeliever will be poor
Whoever is baptized will be immune to death
questions.correctAnswer: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned
questions.explanation: Mark 16:16 (ESV): "Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned."

questions.question: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, what happened to Him?
options: He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God
He walked into a cloud and was never seen by man again
He became a brilliant star that rested over Jerusalem
He entered the new temple to reign as king
questions.correctAnswer: He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God
questions.explanation: Mark 16:19 (ESV): "So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God."

key_verse_text: And he said to them, "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel to the whole creation."
